firstPlayerRule: Whoever fed a pet most recently receives the starting-player token. The rules also permit choosing its holder randomly or by agreement.
officialTieBreak: For shopping groups of equal size, resolve them clockwise beginning with the starting-player token holder. Choosing that token holder randomly is also an official setup alternative.
clarifications: The token does not guarantee the first shopping action. After players reveal their groups, the largest group goes first; its size counts both imps and gold tokens.
